title: Fineline Fishing Charters L.L.C.
specs: Located near Kennedy Space Center Launch Complex on Florida’s Space Coast.
Captain Jim Ross has 30 years of full-time charter fishing experience and hosts a weekly live radio show on saltwater fishing.

blurb: Fineline Fishing Charters offers saltwater fishing trips inshore, nearshore, and offshore around Florida's Space Coast. Trips target species like tarpon, cobia, sharks, and more in areas including Indian River, Banana River, Mosquito Lagoon, and near reefs and wrecks. Captain Jim Ross and his team provide guided fishing adventures for families and seasoned anglers alike.
